text:
alex: starting bring-up for us-central3 GPU cluster. bootstrap run id 2026-03-18-01
maria: which step?
alex: post-bootstrap validation failing. nodes provisioning but kubelet TLS handshake errors and CNI crashing on attach.
lee: saw quota errors in control-plane events earlier: "InsufficientInstanceCapacity: capacity-oversubscribed for g4dn.xlarge"
alex: here's the kubelet tail:
```
Mar 18 00:12:43 k8s-node kubelet[1234]: E03018 00:12:43 server.go: tls: failed to verify certificate
Mar 18 00:12:44 k8s-node cni-plugin[5678]: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```
sam: can you `kubectl get nodes -o wide`?
alex: output: `NotReady  kubelet-not-ready  3m  10.128.0.5` for most nodes
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: bootstrap-v2 applied -> 12/24 nodes joined
maria: is MTU mismatch still possible? we used 9000 on the VPC but host OS default 1500
alex: yes, switching to host MTU fixed a test node (restarted cni). but now control plane api-server spiking 503s
lee: pinged cloud quota team — they confirmed transient spot eviction for the instance type causing kubelet restarts
ops-oncall: suggest pausing scale-up and draining failing nodes, roll forward with smaller instance type
alex: attempted `kubectl drain` but cordon hung due to `eviction` controller errors
infra-bot: recorded incident draft: /incidents/us-central3-bootstrap-2026-03-18
sam: recommend rollback to non-GPU launch template, repro the CNI with 1 node, capture `dmesg` and `journalctl -u kubelet`
maria: agree. also need to update AMI to include proper kernel modules for the GPU driver, current image missing nvidia-uvm
alex: creating runbook for handoff to infra-oncall and AMI team. steps:
  - stop scale-up
  - reproduce on single instance with same AZ
  - collect logs (`journalctl -u kubelet`, `/var/log/cni.log`, `dmesg`)
  - revert to previous launch template
  - notify support teams and resume
lee: tagging @ops-oncall @maria
ops-oncall: taking handoff, will start the rollback now. ETA 20m :hourglass:
alex: thanks. adding output to the thread as I get it. :thumbsup:
